title: Welded Asteroids
description: Asteroids riding a closed-loop stigmergic field: the ship advects on agent-deposited momentum, the rocks are the trail's own beta_1 contours, both projected onto the quotient surfaces of the topology game.

cogdoc.claim: A closed-loop stigmergic field is playable: the ship advects on the same agent-deposited momentum the field's own agents steer by, the obstacles are the coverage-masked beta_1 contours of the trail (so the asteroid count IS the topology readout), and the whole composition survives projection onto non-flat quotients because the field grid and the game already share torus semantics.
